notes.title: Update on Tlatoani release window
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some updates on the development progress of Tlatoani! 


[hr][/hr]

First of all, we’re progressing steadily towards our 1.0 goals! We’re currently aiming for the 1.0 release of Tlatoani to include:

At least 20 historic missions, divided into 3 chapters.

At least 6 Monument buildings

Remaining animations

Improvements to UI and tutorial experience

Additional voiceover and SFX 

Map editor to help with custom map design


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234895/11832b9c131281a9171616b5e3dbe56a7e5fc533.png"]A look at in-development custom scenario editor

What is next?
In the past few months we’ve made good progress with all these features, and are on track to meet the goals we set out to achieve during our Early Access. At this point, we want to ask you for a bit more patience. To make sure Tlatoani is the game we promised you, and an adventure in the Aztec civilization that we can be proud of, we’ll need a little more time.


For that reason we’re moving the release window for Tlatoani 1.0 to Q1 2026. We’ll keep sharing updates as the development progresses, and we hope you’ll keep sharing your feedback and impressions as we go along!

Thank you for your continuous support so far!

notes.title: Roadmap Update and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Since the Early Access launch, we’ve been collecting and collating your feedback, and have been grateful for your detailed - and often passionate - responses, which have been invaluable. Based on this feedback, we've drawn up some plans for the coming weeks, stretching into the new year.

What's Coming Next

We're adding more detailed and complex tooltips to provide reminders of common game functions and make it easier to pick up mechanics as you go.
We're planning some balance adjustments to the early history campaign to ease in the player more gently, although moving into V1 we may be offloading some of the tutorial steps to the learner scenarios instead.
Time allowing, we aim to add the Tizaapan and Cuauhmixtitlan missions to cap off the first chapter of the history campaign before Christmas, at least on the testing branch.
We’re laying the groundwork for broader localization efforts in the new year.
Finally, an in-game help encyclopedia is planned, although this will be a long-term project.


Here’s a sneak peek at some of the upcoming tooltips- let us know what you think!

notes.title: 1.4.1g and 1.4.1h patch update
notes.notes:
This update includes two version-updates from the testing branch:

1.4.1g:
    * Made settlement-initialisation on random maps more forgiving for oasis/river terrain
    * Adjustments to ensure more accurate/reliable provisioning of Basin services
    * Adjustments to priority of road-construction
    * Fix to ensure soldiers at barracks can always be recruited for drilling
    * Preliminary work on moving tutorial-objective descriptions out to .xml
    * Modified dragging behaviour for razing/placement to extend beyond map edge
    * Updated relocations to behave more consistently and interact with razing more correctly
    * Set all good-display functions to use similar/consistent units
    * Other minor fixes and adjustments

1.4.1h:
    * Adjusted claims for gather-buildings to recognise walls and gates more accurately
    * Allowed craft-buildings to assess potential buyers outside their own service range
    * Added some additional starter-buildings for Chapultepec
    * Made fortification-objectives for Epcoac and Tecpayocan a little more forgiving
    * Fix for bugged fruit gardens refusing to build and refusing to delete
    * Other minor fixes and adjustments

notes.notes:

notes.title: 1.4.1e update
notes.notes:
* Expanded map for Epcoac, made animal herds more stable and hunting more viable
    * Ensured Shrine to Tlaloc can supervise farmer huts
    * Allowed favour of Huitzilopochtli to reduce/increase risk of fires
    * Added fruit and ahuejote as separate gardens
    * Added wooden bridges and dirt ramps over cliffs
    * Adjusted display of venue-supervision bonuses
    * Ensured that exports and tribute are prioritised over local storage of goods
    * Fixed cloud-cover fx on lighting being active with weather FX disabled
    * Added VSync option, removed show-framerate toggle (steam offers same function)
    * Added mipmapping to most sprites, adjusted render pipeline to minimise z-fighting
    * Fix for crash in calendar advisor when/if all gods are absent
    * Fix for towers and gatehouses failing to update the pathing-cache correctly
    * Fix for not-a-number errors potentially creeping into inventory
    * Modified migration to consider common and elite unemployment separately
    * Other minor adjustments and fixes
